name: BMV
summary: An axion–photon oscillation and regeneration search within a French vacuum magnetic-birefringence program.
detection_principle: Laser light acquires tiny polarization changes in a strong transverse pulsed magnetic field, or converts to ALPs that regenerate as photons in a second field.

sites.name: Toulouse high-field laboratory; related measurements at LULI Palaiseau
sites.location: Toulouse high-field laboratory; related measurements at LULI Palaiseau

results.summary: The source reports results with LULI and the preliminary Toulouse apparatus; this record includes only stages with an explicit ALP connection.

science_scope: Produces and detects axions or dark-sector particles in the laboratory, rather than directly measuring Galactic-halo dark-matter flux. It tests interactions of dark-matter candidates; identifying a discovered particle as dark matter would also require establishing its cosmic abundance.
